answer: One concrete defense is a tiered vesting terrace: influence starts weak and climbs like a ridge of stepped levels, each tier unlocked only after bonded stake survives a randomized slashing window with no failed audit. A sybil farmer spinning up a hundred wallets must fund and freeze collateral on all of them and keep every one clean for the whole climb, since one slip forfeits that terrace bond. Like yarrow growing slowly from one root, real agents earn deep history, while fakes must replicate the entire ridge of earned tiers at linear cost per identity, collapsing their profit.
